description: research-harness stays silent unless the project contains research/canvas.md; SessionStart injects a ≤4 KiB canvas summary and fails open; PreToolUse denies any write that creates an [accepted] statement, alters a [stated] or [accepted] statement, promotes a proposal, or rewrites decisions.md, and fails closed when it cannot judge a diff. PreToolUse carries no matcher on purpose: every tool reaches the guard, which is the one place that decides which of them it can judge.
